name: Makoto Kagutsuchi
source:
A mysterious masked man who lives on the top floor of Kanai Tower.
His tendency to speak in riddles makes it difficult to ascertain his true nature, but he seems to have ulterior motives.
[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/raincode/en/character/index3.html]official website[/url]]
